tools.title: Designed around how Thai researchers really work
tools.lead: Every tool runs on ThaiJO data, more than {articlesApprox} articles from {journals} journals, supplemented by international databases, and returns results you can trace to their sources.

proposed.title: Future tools
proposed.lead: Gaps in the Thai journal workflow we propose to close next, mostly in editorial work and the steps before submission.

architecture.title: One agent, connected to all Thai journal data
architecture.lead: An open, layered stack. Users work in the Agentic Workspace, where the AI Agent Orchestrator plans each question, picks the Skills that fit and retrieves data through the TCI MCP Gateway & Registry: a single connection point for current and future Skills, MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and APIs. All data passes through a Thai-language pipeline before indexing, and every access follows the user's permissions in ThaiJO.
